name: Sword Fight and Steal Time
desc:
⏰ Gain Time by Staying Alive Outside of the Safe Zone!
🤺 Kill Others to Steal their Time!
⚔️ Unlock New Swords with your Time!
🌟 Obtain New Kill Effects when you Get More Kills!

🎮 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!

🔔 Join the Group for a FREE Sword and Effect!
💬 Join the communications server to stay updated, get support, or connect with fellow sword fighters. 

Sword Fight and Steal Time supports human creativity and does not contain AI-generated images, interface, models, or art.
